briefing.headline: Stripe, Adobe and Workday quietly dropped better B2B roles than anything the keyword score put on top.
briefing.focus: Spend today on the three fresh, sponsorship-safe B2B roles the scorer under-rated: Stripe Lifecycle Growth (remote-US, fintech domain match), Adobe's B2B Performance Marketing Specialist and Workday's Paid Media & ABX Campaign Manager — ABX is ABM, which is the resume's headline skill, and both are F500-scale sponsors that scored 60 only because their JD text was empty. Then do the two Boston/East anchors: CarGurus B2B Marketing Specialist and Datadog's Associate Field Marketing Manager (US East). Skip the Amazon 'AMZ#####' analyst reqs entirely — those are PERM immigration notices, not real openings.

ranked.why: Remote-US lifecycle growth at a fintech that sponsors heavily — 6 years of banking/fintech B2B is the exact domain edge here, and it's brand new to this list.
The only genuine Boston B2B demand-gen role at 'Specialist' level; CarGurus is public and sponsors. Third appearance — if it's still open, apply today or drop it.
Adobe B2B performance marketing at Specialist level; scored 60 only because the JD text was empty — huge sponsor, right function, right seniority.
'ABX' is ABM by another name — this is the single closest match to the resume's lead skill, at a company that files H-1Bs by the hundred.
Marketing Analyst, remote-US, PLG funnel analytics — SQL + MQL/SQL + attribution, both lanes at once. Bullseye despite being seen twice.
'Associate' level Datadog field marketing covering US East — Boston-friendly territory, top-tier sponsor, and the keyword score badly under-rated it at 55 ATS.
Demand-gen measurement frameworks at AWS Marketing — the cleanest analyst-lane fit anywhere on the list; only Seattle relocation and a 3rd appearance hold it back.
Straight PMM ownership of a product GTM at a heavy sponsor; positioning/messaging maps 1:1, no people-management required.
Fresh Datadog PMM opening never pushed before — same team quality as the DEM role, less applicant pileup.
An explicitly Associate-titled PMM at a hot AI company — right level, and the 69 fit score is keyword noise, not judgment.
Posted today, field marketing at a public SaaS company; sales-enablement and event-to-pipeline work is squarely in the resume.
Marketing ops + funnel strategy partner role posted today — Eloqua/HubSpot/Salesforce + attribution is exactly this job.
Fresh today, clean sales-analyst lane fit; Gusto is large enough to sponsor, though no Boston or remote option.
Customer stories and case studies are literally listed on the resume; Datadog sponsors. Docked only for a third showing.
B2B product marketing inside Amazon's B2B unit — best combination of lane fit and sponsorship certainty, but you've now passed twice.
'Audience and Messaging' is segmentation + positioning by another name; Figma has US-wide listing and real sponsorship history.
Promotions analytics is marketing analytics with a different label — analyst lane plus campaign context, at a guaranteed sponsor.
Prospecting-campaign design and pipeline measurement at AWS — scored 61 but is a real demand-gen job at the safest sponsor on the list.
Enterprise-AI PMM at a company that sponsors freely; empty JD dragged the score to 60, not the fit.
Lifecycle marketing with real funnel ownership at a known analytics brand; new to the list, NYC hybrid is the only friction.
Web growth + experimentation at Amplitude — A/B testing and GA4 carry the application; mid-cap sponsor, moderate risk.
Payments/stablecoins PMM is the most direct use of the banking background anywhere here; Stripe is a reliable sponsor.
Associate-level marketing automation is the right rung, but a third appearance says you're not excited — treat as backup.
Associate GTM ops is a strong level and sponsor match, but it's the third push and one of three near-identical Datadog reqs.
Fintech demand gen, right function — but Carta is smaller and this is its third run past you.
MongoDB sponsors well and PLG lifecycle fits, but it's developer-audience growth and you've skipped it twice.
Boston-based business analyst role — location is the whole argument; SimpliSafe's sponsorship track record is thin.
Boston + Amazon is the ideal combination, but 'PMM Technical, AWS Storage' wants deep infrastructure fluency you'd have to fake.
Posted today, campaign marketing at an established sponsor with multiple US locations — low-effort application, unknown level.
Pure ABM at AWS is on-lane, but three appearances plus Arlington-only make it a repeat you've clearly declined.
Fresh analyst req at a guaranteed sponsor; digital-product analytics is adjacent rather than marketing-specific.
Remote-US and Specialist level are right, but Pinterest lifecycle work is consumer CRM, not B2B funnel.
Generic Adobe PMM listing — great sponsor, but no JD means level and team are a coin flip.
Waltham, MA is the only other Boston-area option and GTM consulting uses the funnel skillset — but the 'Consultant' title may mean customer-facing delivery.
Scored 100 on keywords but it's health-insurance sales ops — narrow benefits-domain work, not marketing or growth analytics.
